tasks.subject: Compaction core: 8B cell + descriptor-driven marshalling
tasks.description:
**Goal:** 8B header (rc32|tag16|arity8|scan8) + one uint64/slot, per-slot kind in a Haskell ConDescriptor; encoding semantics unchanged so the oracle stays bit-for-bit. Plan Tasks 1+2 co-landed.

**Files:** runtime/wok_rc.{h,c}, runtime/test/wok_rc_test.c, src/Wok/Interp/RC/Heap.hs (one-word FFI), src/Wok/Interp/RC/Value.hs (SlotKind, stConDesc, encodeSlotC/decodeSlotC, readCCell/readCSlots/allocNCon/dropAddr rework).

**Acceptance Criteria:** sizeof(WokObj)==8, one-word slots, packed-header asserts, arena 8+8*arity; encodeSlotC/decodeSlotC inverse with Int64-fit unchanged (high-bit U64 falls back, no promotion) + HAddr low-bit round-trip; allocNCon records descriptor + writes one word/slot; readCCell/dropAddr descriptor-driven; asan OK + full cabal test green.

**Verify:** bash scripts/asan-runtime.sh && cabal test 2>&1 | tail -6

```json:metadata
{"files": ["runtime/wok_rc.h", "runtime/wok_rc.c", "runtime/test/wok_rc_test.c", "src/Wok/Interp/RC/Heap.hs", "src/Wok/Interp/RC/Value.hs"], "verifyCommand": "bash scripts/asan-runtime.sh && cabal test 2>&1 | tail -6", "acceptanceCriteria": ["sizeof(WokObj)==8, one-word slots, packed header asserts, arena 8+8*arity", "encodeSlotC/decodeSlotC inverse, Int64-fit unchanged, HAddr low-bit round-trip", "allocNCon records descriptor + one word/slot; readCCell/dropAddr descriptor-driven", "asan OK + cabal test green"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Compaction tests: round-trip + high-bit-U64 fallback + sanitizer
tasks.description:
**Goal:** descriptor round-trip property + high-bit-U64-falls-back differential test + one-word raw-FFI test + sanitizer on 8B struct. Plan Task 3.

**Files:** test/Spec.hs, scripts/asan-runtime.sh.

**Acceptance Criteria:** round-trip property (incl negative HAddr, Int64 boundaries); high-bit-U64 field identical both backends (falls back); wokRcHeapTests one-word; asan green on 8B.
